title: Owner-gate triage
_doc: Used by lib/governance.decide() for a category the owner set to 'triage'. proceed-notify = the act goes ahead and the owner is told (like notify); escalate = it waits for the owner (like approve). Conservative: only small, reversible, non-recurring acts with known counterparts pass. Spend passes only under the owner-set maxSpendUsd, which ships at 0 (nothing passes). Fixed owner gates never reach this model. docs/DECISION-MODELS.md.

amountUsd.doc: money this act commits, in USD

recurring.doc: the cost or act repeats on its own

vendorKnown.doc: the vendor is one the company already pays

seatHistoryOk.doc: the deciding seat has no open correction or recent revert in this area

reversible.doc: the act can be undone fully by the company

externalRecipientKnown.doc: an outbound act goes to a recipient already on the allowlist or in prior correspondence

summary.doc: the act in one line (not used by rules; kept out of the log)

maxSpendUsd.doc: spend strictly below this may proceed-notify; 0 = no spend passes. Set by the owner: decide.js set-param gate-triage maxSpendUsd <n> --by <owner>

rules.why: a fixed owner gate is always the owner's
people, budget and new lines of business stay with the owner
recurring, or not known to be a one-off
the amount is at or above the owner's triage threshold
small one-off reversible spend to a known vendor, under the owner's threshold
spend without a known vendor or a stated amount
reversible outbound act to a known recipient by a seat in good standing
reversible one-off change by a seat in good standing

default.why: nothing shows this is safe to do alone
